othello.connectionFailed: Connection failed. Please check the Peer ID.

rules.rule1: Black plays first. Players take turns placing discs on the board.
rules.rule2: Place a disc to flip at least one opponent disc.
rules.rule3: Flip all opponent discs in a straight line between your new disc and another of your discs.
rules.rule4: The game ends when neither player can move. Most discs wins!
